name: VRoar
summary: This indie developed VR art game allows the user to see their vocal expression directly affect the graphics in a variety of fun ways. You can make trees by navigating through the landscape with the joystick; blobs appear with each detected onset (so making lots of short sounds will quickly generate a flock of blobs), these blend to a different texture depending on changes in certain sound features and comic clouds distort and dance based on the sound you make.
